api: VCF Automation provisioning service - Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) API
specificationAvailability: VCF Automation ships no machine-readable API specification in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0). The reference pages listed below are the authoritative public description of these operations, so docs/contract.json was transcribed from them by hand.

pages.documents: xAPIs catalogue index; used to establish that the VCF Automation provisioning service reference (VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service) is the current home of the IaaS API and that no downloadable specification is offered for it.
API overview: title 'VMware Aria Automation Assembler IaaS API', version 9.1 (latest), base path /iaas/api, and the tag list that contains Cloud Account, Request and About.
Operation index; used to enumerate the vSphere cloud account operations, the request tracker operations and the about operation, together with their methods and paths.
GET /iaas/api/about ('Get About Page'): declares no query parameters and returns latestApiVersion plus the supportedApis collection.

GET /iaas/api/cloud-accounts-vsphere/{id} ('Get V Sphere Cloud Account'): optional apiVersion query parameter, and the 200 response fields including hostName, username, dcid, customProperties and the enabledRegions objects (externalRegionId, name, cloudAccountId).

PATCH /iaas/api/cloud-accounts-vsphere/{id} ('Update V Sphere Cloud Account Async'): required apiVersion query parameter, the UpdateCloudAccountVsphereSpecification request body with its required (name, hostName, regions) and optional fields, the 202 RequestTracker response and the 403/404 ServiceErrorResponse responses with their field names.

POST /iaas/api/cloud-accounts-vsphere ('Create V Sphere Cloud Account Async'): consulted only for the shape of the shared sub-objects - the regions entries (name, externalRegionId), tags (key, value) and certificateInfo (certificate). The create operation itself is deliberately not part of docs/contract.json.
GET /iaas/api/request-tracker ('Get Request Trackers'): apiVersion is the only documented query parameter, and the 200 response is a page of trackers with content, totalElements and numberOfElements.

GET /iaas/api/request-tracker/{id} ('Get Request Tracker'): optional apiVersion query parameter and the RequestTracker 200 response (progress, message, status with values FINISHED/INPROGRESS/FAILED, resources, name, id, selfLink, deploymentId).
